title: Sorcerer and the Storm Rat
description: A blue-skinned sorcerer in purple robes and crown stands in a lily pond holding a glowing orb and chained to a giant spectral mouse with glowing yellow eyes. In the background a red-sailed ship with silhouetted figures rests atop the mouse's back under a dramatic stormy sky with lightning.
prompt: A blue-skinned sorcerer wearing a crown and flowing purple robes stands in a magical pond filled with lily pads, holding a glowing orb in one hand and a heavy chain in the other. The chain leads to a massive ghostly grey mouse with glowing yellow eyes that has a small red-sailed ship on its back with three silhouetted figures. The scene is set in a dark swampy landscape with glowing magical books, eye symbols, candles, and strange plants under a turbulent stormy sky with dramatic lightning strikes.
